records.claim: Some studies on nitrofurantoin have suggested an increased chance of birth defects with use in pregnancy. However, study design flaws make some of the results in these studies questionable. There are also many studies on nitrofurantoin use in pregnancy that did not find birth defects. Overall, an increased chance for birth defects has not been confirmed.
